site.domainNote: museum/university herbarium public lobby kiosk for searching digitized plant specimen sheets

regions.label: Dark green kiosk top bar: serif 'Herbarium Kiosk' wordmark (home button) with 'Lobby' subtitle, outlined 'Featured exhibit' and 'Start over' buttons
Eyebrow with collection count, large serif H1, intro paragraph, and big search field with green Search button
'Quick starts for the Penstemon collection': 2x2 grid of outlined tappable cards, each with a serif result count, bold title, description and arrow; touch-instructions note below
Featured exhibit card with illustrated herbarium sheet and 'Read the exhibit →', a tinted 'Oldest Lane County sheet' callout card, and kiosk timeout note

evidence.note: Persistent kiosk top bar with identity (home button) and nav landmark 'Kiosk' with two global actions
Large outlined search input with example-query placeholder; visually hidden label 'Search the herbarium'
Horizontal outlined card, whole card is a button; large serif count on left, title + description, arrow on right

evidence.quote: Pressed in Place: 125 Years of Oregon Collectors
evidence.note: Exception: vertical featured card with illustrated specimen image and 'Read the exhibit →' link, whole card is one button

evidence.quote: Oldest Lane County sheet in the kiosk

patterns.rationale: The aside surfaces an editorially featured exhibit ('Featured this month') and a highlighted specimen; this is curated promotion rather than behaviour-based recommendation, so it may be better read as editorial content.

evidence.note: Counts in quick-start cards are result counts on navigational presets, not KPI tiles
Quick starts are preset searches presented as cards, not AI prompt chips
Only the search entry screen is captured; no results list
No facets on the captured welcome screen (they exist on the next screen only)

structure.layout: single-screen kiosk welcome: dark top bar, two-column body with left search hero + 2x2 preset-search card grid and right sidebar of featured cards; no scrolling

aesthetics.typography: Georgia serif for H1, H2, wordmark, featured exhibit title and the large counts in quick-start cards; system-ui sans for body, buttons, card titles, eyebrows (uppercase letterspaced); Courier New for tiny specimen label text inside the illustration
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast: 52px/600 serif H1, 26px serif featured title, 30px serif counts, 22px serif H2, 17–19px body/card titles, 13–14px eyebrows and descriptions

notes: Touch kiosk for a herbarium lobby: big touch targets (48–60px buttons, 106px cards), explicit touch instructions ('Touch a sheet… Pinch or use the buttons to zoom') and inactivity-timeout notice. Paper/parchment cream background with forest-green header and primary button evokes archival herbarium sheets; specimen illustration is an SVG drawing of a pressed plant on a mounted sheet with tape corners and a typewritten label. No shadows at all; cards distinguished by 1px warm-beige borders and off-white fill. Arrows (→) are text glyphs rather than icons. Quick-start cards act as preset saved searches with result counts.
